high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing on a beach, facing the ocean. The individual is wearing a dark-colored hoodie or jacket with a hood that is up, covering most of their head and face. They also appear to be wearing glasses. The background shows a vast expanse of the ocean with waves gently crashing onto the shore. The sky is overcast, giving the scene a somewhat muted and subdued atmosphere. The sand on the beach is light-colored, and there are some small objects scattered on it, possibly shells or debris from the sea.
